name: BigCommerce
description_en:
BigCommerce is a hosted ecommerce platform for storefronts, checkout, catalogue and order operations, with B2B, headless and multi-storefront options. It provides visual storefront tools and APIs, allowing an integrated application or a more conventional hosted store.

The current commercial structure differs from older Standard/Plus/Pro descriptions: its official 2026 update renames self-service plans Core, Growth and Scale. Costs now depend on sales thresholds, payment-provider classification and potentially storefronts or extensions, so an unqualified “no transaction fees” description would be misleading.
description_zh:
BigCommerce 是托管电商平台，提供店面、结账、商品目录及订单运营，并可扩展 B2B、无头及多店面。它同时提供可视化店面工具和 API，可用于集成式应用或常规托管网店。

当前商业结构已不同于旧 Standard／Plus／Pro：官方 2026 更新将自助套餐改称 Core、Growth、Scale。费用取决于销售阈值、支付服务商类别，以及可能的店面和扩展项，因此不能笼统写成“不收交易费”。

core_features.explanation_en: Manage products, orders and checkout with theme tools and API extension options.
core_features.explanation_zh: 通过主题工具及 API 扩展管理商品、订单和结账。

core_features.explanation_en: Core and Growth thresholds use trailing twelve-month GMV, with automatic upgrade rules.
core_features.explanation_zh: Core、Growth 按过去 12 个月 GMV 阈值自动升级。

core_features.name_zh: 按支付服务商类别计费
core_features.explanation_en: Open-provider orders can incur a platform fee separate from payment processing.
core_features.explanation_zh: 开放类别支付服务商处理的订单可能另收平台费，与支付处理费分开。

review_notes: Vendor descriptions are documentation evidence, not independent validation.
Examples and suitability judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese copy does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.title_en: Follow one physical-product order end to end
sections.title_zh: 完整跟踪一笔实物商品订单
sections.en: Begin with one product variant, stock location, shipping method and payment provider. The platform covers storefront, checkout and orders; the trial can take payments only after a payment partner is configured. Evaluate a paid order, cancellation and stock correction. Headless presentation adds frontend and API integration work; it does not remove the payment or fulfilment configuration. This research created no store or transactions.
sections.zh: 可从一个商品规格、库存地点、配送方式和支付服务商开始。平台覆盖店面、结账及订单；试用中也需配置支付伙伴才能收款。建议评估付款订单、取消及库存修正。无头展示会增加前端和 API 集成工作，并不会取消支付和履约配置。本文未创建店铺或交易。

sections.title_en: Use the current Core, Growth and Scale model
sections.title_zh: 使用当前 Core、Growth、Scale 模型
sections.en: The retrieved US pricing lists annual-billing equivalents of US$29, US$79 and US$299 per month, versus monthly prices of US$39, US$105 and US$399. Core and Growth have US$30,000 and US$100,000 trailing-twelve-month GMV thresholds. Scale lists a US$33,333 monthly GMV allowance with 0.9% on excess. These are vendor-defined GMV units, not net profit or bank settlement. Confirm the selected plan and applicable transition timing for an existing annual contract.
sections.zh: 读取的美国定价列出年付折算每月 29、79、299 美元，对应逐月付款 39、105、399 美元。Core、Growth 的过去 12 个月 GMV 阈值分别为 30,000、100,000 美元。Scale 列有每月 33,333 美元 GMV 额度，超额部分费率 0.9%。这是厂商定义的 GMV，不是净利润或银行到账额。原年付合同应确认实际套餐及适用转换时间。

sections.title_en: Add the open-provider fee only to the applicable orders
sections.title_zh: 只对适用订单计入开放支付服务商费用
sections.en: The update lists Open Payment Provider fees of 2.0% on Core, 1.0% on Growth and 0.6% on Scale. Embedded-provider orders are exempt from that platform fee; the actual processor of each order determines treatment, not merely which buttons appear at checkout. Processing fees remain separate. The update also includes offline/manual methods in scope. Estimate using the intended provider mix and vendor GMV definition; no billing calculation was executed here.
sections.zh: 更新页列出的开放支付服务商费率为 Core 2.0%、Growth 1.0%、Scale 0.6%。嵌入类别服务商订单免收这项平台费，依据是每笔订单实际处理方，而不只是结账页展示哪些按钮；支付处理费仍另计。更新页还把线下／手工方法列入范围。应按拟用支付组合和厂商 GMV 定义估算，本文未实际计算账单。

sections.title_en: Plan for extensions and trial expiry
sections.title_zh: 规划扩展费用及试用到期
sections.en: Multi-storefront and B2B capabilities need plan-specific checks; Feedonomics and Makeswift are separately named products in the wider family. The pricing FAQ offers a 15-day trial, followed by an inaccessible storefront if no plan is chosen, and describes 90-day retention before deletion. Arrange exports and a paid launch decision before expiry. A trial is not sustained free hosting.
sections.zh: 多店面和 B2B 能力需按套餐核对；Feedonomics、Makeswift 是更广产品家族中的独立名称。定价 FAQ 提供 15 天试用，未选套餐后店面不可访问，并说明保留 90 天后删除。应在到期前安排导出及是否付费上线，试用不是持续免费托管。

sections.title_en: Choose based on operations and total cost
sections.title_zh: 按运营需求及总费用选型
sections.en: BigCommerce is relevant to merchants needing managed commerce with extension options. A team wanting unrestricted self-hosted software should resolve that mismatch first. Prepare catalogue data, payment eligibility, shipping rules and ownership of integrations. Product claims do not establish uptime, conversion gains or SEO results; no live checkout, API recovery, source licence or contractual SLA was verified.
sections.zh: 需要托管电商及扩展选项的商家可评估 BigCommerce；想要无限制自托管软件的团队应先核对差异。应准备商品数据、收款资格、配送规则及集成负责人。产品主张不能证明可用率、转化提升或 SEO 结果；本文未核实真实结账、API 恢复、源码许可或合同 SLA。
